title: Dunya and the River That Argued
logline: Dunya fights Layla until they discover they were always the same water.
story: Certain they were opposites and enemies, Dunya, who carried the world and its pull, ran headlong against Layla, who was unseen current from within. Each tried to push the other back uphill, and they struggled until both were spent and still. In that stillness Dunya noticed they had pooled together and could no longer tell which water had been which. What Dunya had fought so hard in Layla was only the part of Dunya that had never been lived. Joined, they became a river wide enough to carry them both.
moral: What you fight hardest in another is most often the unlived part of yourself.
